title: Open-Meteo historical archive, Shanghai grid point, 4-8 December 2015-2025
claims: The archive request for 31.2304N, 121.4737E returned the grid point 31.247803N, 121.5E at 5 m elevation.
For 6 December across 2015-2025, the grid point gives daily maximum temperatures from 10.1 to 18.0 C with a median of 12.6 C, and daily minimum temperatures from -1.3 to 7.2 C with a median of 4.6 C.
Two of the eleven 6 December days recorded at least 1 mm of daily precipitation: 6.1 mm in 2015 and 23.5 mm in 2018.
These are reanalysis grid-point values, not measurements on the race course.

verification.checkedVia: PowerShell Invoke-WebRequest 经 127.0.0.1:7890 请求 archive-api.open-meteo.com，解析 daily.time/temperature_2m_max/temperature_2m_min/precipitation_sum
verification.note: 返回网格 31.247803 / 121.5，elevation 5 m；2015-12-04 至 2025-12-08 共 55 个日值，其中 11 个 12 月 6 日值用于统计。第二次请求触发 daily API limit，统计基于首次成功响应，不重试。

claimVerification.note: Open-Meteo archive 是再分析网格，不是赛道仪器；页面正文明确写“网格点历史统计，不是赛道实测”。
